run_human_agent: run the human agent to interact with DeepMind Alchemy via keyboard and mouse controls
create_environment_settings: create EnvironmentSettings with a seed, level name, width, and height for the Alchemy environment
load_from_docker: load the Alchemy environment from a Docker image using load_from_docker as a context manager
step_environment: step the environment with an action dictionary and receive a timestep with observations and rewards
grab_mouse: toggle mouse grab mode to enable or disable relative mouse movement for camera control
